title: ForestDiffusion for Medical Indicators Prediction
summary: A repository comparing generative methods, including ForestDiffusion, for tabular data synthesis applied to medical indicator prediction tasks. It uses SDV's single-table synthesizers (CTGAN, GaussianCopula, TVAE) as baseline generators to produce synthetic data for comparison against the main ForestDiffusion method.
evidence: ForestDiffusion/script_generation.py:259-311 instantiates CTGANSynthesizer, GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, TVAESynthesizer via sdv.single_table and fits/samples them
